question.knowledge_point: Finding the Coefficient Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
question.problem:
What is the coefficient matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}\{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 9y=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y,z$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}\{\begin{aligned}5x-8y+z=-1 \\ 0x+9y+0z=2 \\ 3x-y-8z=-4\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}5 & \,\,\,-8 & 1 \\ 0 & 9 & 0 \\ 3 & \,\,\,-1 & \,\,\,-8\end{aligned}]
$$

question.knowledge_point: Finding the Augmented Matrix of a System of Linear Equations
question.problem:
What is the augmented matrix for the following system of linear equations?

$$
\begin{aligned}\{\begin{aligned}2x-5=3y \\ 6+y=4x\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
question.worked_solution:
First, we organize the system so that the variables are ordered $x,y$ on the left-hand side, the constants are on the right-hand side, and every variable has a coefficient:

$$
\begin{aligned}\{\begin{aligned}2x-3y=5 \\ -4x+y=-6\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

The coefficient matrix consists of the coefficients of the variables:

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 \\ -4 & 1\end{aligned}]
$$

The augmented matrix  is the coefficient matrix augmented with the column that represents the right-hand sides of the equations: 

$$
[\begin{aligned}2 & -3 & 5 \\ -4 & 1 & -6\end{aligned}]
$$

question.knowledge_point: Finding the System of Equations Associated With an Augmented Matrix
question.problem:
What would be the system of equations for the following augmented matrix?

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & -8 & 4 & -\frac{7}{4} \\ 0 & 5 & \frac{2}{3} & 8 \\ \frac{3}{2} & \frac{1}{3} & 4 & 6\end{aligned}]
$$
question.worked_solution:
The augmented matrix consists of two parts: the coefficient matrix and the column of constants.

The coefficient matrix represents the coefficients in the linear system, while the column of constants represents the constants on the right-hand sides of the equations.

Using the variables $x$, $y$, and $z,$ then, the corresponding system of equations is

$$
\{\begin{aligned}0x-8y+4z=-\frac{7}{4} \\ 0x+5y+\frac{2}{3}z=8 \\ \frac{3}{2}x+\frac{1}{3}y+4z=6.\end{aligned}
$$

By simplifying, we obtain 

$$
\{\begin{aligned}-8y+4z=-\frac{7}{4} \\ 5y+\frac{2}{3}z=8 \\ \frac{3}{2}x+\frac{1}{3}y+4z=6.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
[\begin{aligned}0 & 8 & 6 \\ 4 & 1 & -9\end{aligned}]
$$

$$
\{\begin{aligned}0x+8y=6 \\ 4x+y=-9.\end{aligned}
$$

$$
\{\begin{aligned}8y=6 \\ 4x+y=-9.\end{aligned}
